Hi all — quick technical confirmation ahead of go/no-go:

- Private deployment: Redwood can provision the private endpoint on our staging cluster by 2026-04-16 given the updated schedule.
- SSO/SCIM: we need the IdP metadata and a test user. Priya — can you share the IdP metadata and a test account by 2026-03-25?
- KMS: to enable customer-managed keys we require either KMS access or a key-wrapping flow. Alex/Priya — please advise preferred approach.
- SOC 2 evidence: legal requested SOC 2 Type II report — attaching redwood-sla-summary.pdf (summary). Full SOC 2 can be shared under NDA/secure link.

Success criteria checklist (technical):
1) Network firewall rules validated and private endpoint reachable.
2) SSO authentication & test user validated.
3) KMS/config for encryption in place.
4) Performance runs meet 95th p95 latency targets in staging.

I’ll own the staging deploy and performance validation. If the above are satisfied, Camila/Marissa can move to signature.

Attachments: redwood-sla-summary.pdf
